LanguageData.EES_CommanderShield.label: commander shield
LanguageData.EES_CommanderShield.description: A mobile projectile barrier deployed around the commander. It blocks both direct-fire and arcing projectiles.
LanguageData.EES_CommanderShieldBelt.label: shield belt (commander)
LanguageData.EES_CommanderShieldBelt.description: A military shield projector worn by the defense officer. It deploys an 8-tile radius barrier around the wearer against both direct-fire and arcing projectiles. It cannot be looted.
